svg.title: DOT-Design system context and supported runtime mappings
svg.desc: DOT authors combine capabilities, contracts, anchors, service bindings, configuration, and runtime declarations in dot.json. DOT-Schema and dotx validate the reusable definition, DOT-Registry publishes and resolves it, and a separate composition pins instances and wires. The dotx lifecycle layer deploys Docker images, Docker Compose, Kubernetes manifests, Helm charts, and Vagrantfiles. WebAssembly modules are represented by the domain model but require an external lifecycle adapter.
